engine.name: tbd — voice route unresolved; no preview catalogue on this machine
engine.note: Engine and supported controls are confirmed only after the voice-route benchmark. Any control not in supportedControls is an explicit limitation, never silently ignored.

benchmark.selectionMethod: benchmark the candidate previews on the same 15-20 s passage of this script (hook, turn, re-hook, soft close), then select one consistent voice for all fourteen shots s1-s10 and a1-a4
benchmark.whyPending: vietnamese-voice-samples/previews/ does not exist on this machine (the parent folder holds only .DS_Store). `ls vietnamese-voice-samples/previews/` and `python3 -m unittest scripts.test_voice_catalog` could not be executed: this runtime has no shell or process-execution tool. No slug is invented here.

keyPlan.note: s1-s10 are the owner's ten mandatory lines, verbatim and in the owner's original order. a1-a4 are the four [ADD] sensory connectors justified in script.md section 5; they are counted in the 142-syllable total. The trailing END title card is silence and has no key. scripts/gen-voice-clone.py walks voice.proposed.json in insertion order, so this order is the playback order.

pauseImplementation: explicit post-synthesis silence during phrase assembly; never inferred from punctuation or ellipsis. The post-clip hold of each shot (minimumPostClipHoldSeconds) is a real gap between two clips in the timeline, not padding inside the clip, so every measured clip duration contains speech only.

experimentalCues.note: [cười], [thở dài], [hắng giọng] and similar non-spoken cues remain disabled unless a local benchmark proves the installed engine renders them as intended without leaking into narration or captions.

s1.intent: HOOK + frame-0 cover: name the viewer's role; the on-screen text must carry it with the sound off
s1.emotion: curious, warm, direct, slightly rueful recognition
s1.tempoIntent: hook: brisk on the opening phrase, settle through the middle, hard stop at the end
s1.ending: flat, level — a statement, not a question
s1.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after clip, not punctuation

phrases.text: Mọi người thường tìm đến bạn

s2.intent: First concrete proof of the hook: state the known fact about them, in three separate statements
s2.tempoIntent: conversational triad; each sentence lands separately; weight on the last phrase

phrases.text: Biết làm sao để người khác thấy ổn hơn.

a1.intent: [ADD] Show the effect the previous line only asserted, and plant the contrast the turn lands on
a1.tempoIntent: even; the second sentence slightly lower, no pathos
a1.ending: falling, leaves the floor open for the turn
a1.postClipHoldPolicy: the largest early beat — timeline silence after clip so the turn has air

phrases.text: Vai người khác nhẹ hẳn xuống.

s3.intent: HIGHLIGHT 1 — the turn: alone with the phone
s3.tempoIntent: the hinge: plain opening, slow through the middle so the duration is audible, flat ending

phrases.text: chính bạn lại ngồi rất lâu trước màn hình điện thoại.

a2.intent: [ADD] Put the room's sound into a story that otherwise has no audible environment
a2.emotion: quietest read so far, almost said to the room
a2.tempoIntent: slowest, even, no rubato; the repetition is gentle, not theatrical
a2.postClipHoldPolicy: withheld-message beat — timeline silence before the re-hook

s4.intent: RE-HOOK — say the message she cannot send, in her own imagined voice
s4.tempoIntent: slower than the previous shot; the quoted message softer than the narration
s4.ending: falling on the quoted words, no fade
s4.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after clip — the draft is left hanging

s5.intent: Give the verdict on her own small decision
s5.emotion: rueful, close to a shrug, never self-pity
s5.tempoIntent: light first half, settling downward on the second

a3.intent: [ADD] The re-hook's answer: report the deletion — the give-up has to be seen
a3.emotion: plain; the image carries the emotion, the voice does not
a3.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after clip — the deletion is seen before anyone corrects the assumption

s6.intent: Correct an assumption the viewer is already making
s6.emotion: gentle, direct, looking at the viewer
s6.tempoIntent: level, then a small lowering on the last phrase
s6.ending: falling, leaves the answer to s7

phrases.text: Không phải vì không có ai

s7.intent: Say the true reason she did not send it — the truest line in the video
s7.emotion: the truest, quietest, least performed line here
s7.tempoIntent: slowest real line; the first phrase almost offhand, the second slow with the last two words dropping in volume
s7.ending: stops; the last two words drop in level but never fade to a whisper
s7.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after clip — the recognition lands in it

phrases.text: với việc mình phải là người ổn.

s8.intent: Ask whether anyone is still there — a breath-word, not a stage aside
s8.tempoIntent: short, unhurried; the ellipsis is not performed
s8.postClipHoldPolicy: the longest beat in the video — timeline silence after clip, never the punctuation

s9.intent: HIGHLIGHT 2 — deliver the umbrella metaphor honestly
s9.tempoIntent: conversational through the first phrase, then slow on the reversal so it is audible rather than announced
s9.postClipHoldPolicy: umbrella landing hold — timeline silence after clip

phrases.text: Người thường xuyên che ô cho người khác
cũng có những ngày bị ướt.

a4.intent: [ADD] Make the metaphor visible: the umbrella tilts and the rain lands on her
a4.emotion: quiet, almost clinical — stating a physical fact is the whole point
a4.tempoIntent: level on both sentences; the second quieter than the first
a4.ending: falling, hands the frame to the closing question

s10.intent: HIGHLIGHT 3 and the climax — ask the viewer the question nobody asks them; last spoken shot of the video
s10.emotion: warmest and most open, still not loud
s10.tempoIntent: unhurried setup, then the quoted question at normal volume with a real question contour
s10.ending: rising then held open; the final word falls; no call to action
s10.postClipHoldPolicy: after this clip the voice stops; the END card is 2.40 s of total silence

limitations: The voice reference is unresolved: vietnamese-voice-samples/previews/ does not exist on this machine and no slug is proposed. All fourteen reference fields stay pending until the catalogue test and the benchmark are run.

The VieNeu clone supports only seed, denoise, local reference and silence padding. rate, pitch, volume, speed, atempo and style are unavailable and are requested nowhere in this file; all pacing and intensity direction is read by the voice-agent from phrase intent, not from the engine.
All non-spoken cues stay disabled: no [cười], no [thở dài], no [hắng giọng] and no actingCue field anywhere.
Silence is real: pauseBeforeSeconds/pauseAfterSeconds pad inside one clip, and minimumPostClipHoldSeconds is a gap between two clips in the timeline. No beat is ever created with punctuation.
Naturalness, intimacy and emotional delivery are not verifiable from this file or from ASR; only the voice-agent's measured clip data and the user's optional listen can confirm them.

The 3.9 syl/s planning rate is an assumption. Measured clips decide the final timeline; the plan stays inside 45-55 s from 4.2 down to 3.7 syl/s (script.md section 4 gives the elasticity order in both directions).
